batch110 — independent read-only review
Snapshot: candidate 1cf02f67cd180038532ab18e1c2c0e742a3f6ca8; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 2a6329e09f1be16f3978552cb4112cf8723910a5. Opening and closing gates both returned exit 0; four new strokes raw-identical.
Scope: All requested guidance/rubric windows; four complete EN/RU new lessons; 12 complete EN/RU context pairs; comparison article (all windows) and three EN-only word pages; 13 KANJIDIC2 records, radical/header, 43 JMdict entries, four KanjiPedia entries; all 381 current typed rows; proposals, adjudications, clarifications, overlaps and six navigation diffs. Every window returned complete with exit 0; none unread.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, counts, radical, meanings, examples and sourced structural accounts match the frozen source and bound official evidence; mnemonics are clearly labeled. No confirmed Japanese defect.
C2 CLEAN: Six edits are standalone-glyph link wrappers only, to existing correct targets; no visible prose or metadata change. New-lesson links target available RU words or same-directory kanji; unavailable words/article remain plain text. All 12 direct meaning-title directions are distinct against the listed ordinary senses; no reverse/transitive inference. This is content-level review, not runtime quiz acceptance.
C3 CLEAN: Four lessons are understandable Russian, preserve Japanese learner content, distinguish meanings from mnemonics and explain absent-RU-page terms without requiring English.
N001市→席 S-intro: 市 city/market vs 席 seat, gathering-place or post; a broad location category is not a direct answer.
N002市→常 S-intro: city/market vs usual, constant or always; distinct ordinary senses.
N003市→師 S-intro: city/market vs teacher, master or specialist; distinct ordinary senses.
N004師→帰 S-intro: teacher/master/specialist vs return/homecoming; KANJIDIC2 and current title support distinction.
N005師→市 S-intro: specialist/teacher vs city/market; shared シ reading is not a meaning overlap.
N006師→姉 S-intro: teacher/specialist vs older sister; 姉’s respectful suffix and shared シ reading do not make the displayed title a meaning answer.
N007席→度 S-intro: seat/place/position vs degree or occasion/count; event proximity is not a shared answer.
N008席→庭 S-intro: seat or gathering-place vs garden/yard; generic place relation is not synonymy.
N009席→市 S-intro: seat/place/position vs city/market; no direct shared ordinary sense.
N010常→堂 S-intro: usual/constant vs hall/temple; distinct ordinary senses.
N011常→帰 S-intro: usual/constant vs return/homecoming; distinct ordinary senses.
N012常→席 S-intro: usual/constant vs seat/place/post; distinct ordinary senses.
L001市 SUPPORTED: title, readings, market/city senses and 形声 explanation supported; 市場’s dictionary note on usual いちば reading is accurately bounded.
L002師 SUPPORTED: title, profession examples, standalone/suffix senses and attributed 会意 account supported; いくさ is accurately disclosed as unused.
L003席 SUPPORTED: title and seat/gathering place/position/post senses supported; attributed 形声 account and mnemonic boundary accurate.
L004常 SUPPORTED: title/readings and the distinctions among 常, 非常, 非常に and 非常口 are supported; attributed origin and modern-shape mnemonic are correctly separated.
A001 SUPPORTED: JMdict いちば/しじょう entries and the limited street-market reading note are represented accurately; no frequency claim.
A002 SUPPORTED: 師 meanings and specialist suffix are bounded; non-taught senses/forms are not misrepresented.
A003 SUPPORTED: 席 senses are accurately summarized; search-only むしろ spelling is not taught as ordinary.
A004 SUPPORTED: とこ- and the ordinary/emergency/extreme distinction are accurate; rare とわ is not overclaimed.
NAV01 words/出席.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps existing 席, correct ../kanji/席.md target.
NAV02 words/市.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 市, correct ../kanji/市.md target.
NAV03 words/市場.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 市, correct ../kanji/市.md target.
NAV04 words/市民.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 市, correct ../kanji/市.md target.
NAV05 words/席.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 席, correct ../kanji/席.md target.
NAV06 words/非常に.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 常, correct ../kanji/常.md target.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD: 市/町 share a city-domain gloss and 場 relates to 市場; neither is a direct distractor edge here. O002 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD: 先/者/教 are related person or teaching terms, not direct 師 foils. O003 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD: 座 has stronger seat/place-title overlap and 場 shares place; 出 relates to 出席; none is a direct 席 foil here. O004 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD: 毎/日 are habitual/temporal neighbors, not direct 常 foils.
Findings: none.
Optional: none.
Limits: No web pages consulted. No tests, validators, runtime quiz/UI, reader, device or activation behavior evaluated, as prohibited/outside assigned evidence. The three EN-only comparison pages were read as contextual evidence; no RU counterparts were claimed. Verdicts apply only to this bounded batch.
